options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color
Off: keys, buttons or dragging only

fields.name: buttons
fields.label: Buttons
fields.value: LEFT=left, RIGHT=right, UP=up, DOWN=down, PREV=left, NEXT=right, OK=a, KEY1=a, BUTTON=a, BOOT=a, AI=a, KEY2=b, HOME=b, REFRESH=start, KEY3=start
fields.description: Which GPIO key does what: LABEL=action, with left, right, up, down, a (fire), b (bomb) and start (pause). A key not named here fires.
